title: Chapter 209 Conspiracy With The Demon Clan
content:
Chapter 209 Conspiracy With The Demon Clan

Wu Qing obtained some important intelligence from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce. He was not stingy and used a transport host to deliver a batch of Zerg energy coins to Gong Zhe.

GOOGLE search TWKAN

Gong Zhe saw the Zerg transport host. From his perspective as a businessman, he couldn't help but sigh: "This is the perfect caravan transportation tool. It's a pity that the Zerg don't go into business!"

Wu Qing smiled and didn't respond.

According to the background setting of the game, the Zerg host is a transport ship for Zerg space travel. In this real world, it is impossible to estimate to what extent it can eventually evolve.

Gong Zhe happily accepted the Zerg energy coins. This time the intelligence transaction was completed, and everyone was happy.

...

For the next three days, nothing major happened, and everything about the Zerg was proceeding according to the predetermined plan.

After these days of actual combat training, the strength of the alliance army has been qualitatively improved. With the support of the inheritance of the Tiancan Jiubian Gongfa, they have grown from an ordinary army to an elite army.

Wu Qing would issue a combat mission to the alliance army every day, and the difficulty of the mission would increase every day, constantly urging them to make progress.

Later, the alliance army directly participated in the siege of large cities. They had to capture the enemy city with a large population with the cooperation of a small number of Zerg puppies.

This level of battle can allow them to exert their full strength.

After these days of actual running-in, the alliance army has basically built a skeleton. With the continuous development of the alliance, the scale of this army will become larger and larger, and it will eventually become a force that cannot be ignored in this world.

With the unlimited inheritance of the Tiancan Jiubian Gongfa, their future potential is unlimited.

The Daxia cavalry led by Wu Cong is a real elite force in itself. Together with the Zerg puppies, they keep fighting everywhere, attacking cities and killing countless enemies.

With the inheritance of the Tiancan Jiubian Gongfa and the Zerg warhorse mounts given to them by Wu Qing, their combat power has been multiplied.

In every battle between the Daxia cavalry and the Zerg puppies, they charge forward, and their ferocity is no less than that of the Zerg puppies!

In addition, the enemy does not have many strong troops, and they are protected by the Zerg biological colonization suits that have undergone multiple evolutions. The gap in strength between the enemy and us is obvious, and it is impossible to find an enemy of equal strength.

The strength of the enemy is actually not very important. As long as enough energy and luck are plundered, with the assistance of the silkworm, the soldiers of the Daxia cavalry can quickly recover their strength. Even in the case of the same star level, the combat power is several levels higher than before.

It is still very difficult for the Daxia cavalry, which has only 2,000 soldiers, to expand its forces. It is better to be short than to be excessive. Without the corresponding strength, after considerable testing, Wu Qing will not let anyone easily join this cavalry named after Daxia.

The Zerg army's sweep of the territory of the bear goblins has a gratifying record. The Zerg flying dragon group, which has recovered to 60,000 troops, uses their super-fast flying speed and powerful attack ability. With the support of the intelligence of the Zerg host, it took three days to destroy all the main cities in the territory of the bear goblins.

The Zerg host monitored that some of the high-level members of the bear goblins had left with important supplies.

Now, the territory of the bear goblins only has some cities that can be easily captured by the alliance army. These cities will not last long. The Zerg dragon group has begun to divide its troops and attack these weak cities.

Millions of Zerg puppies entered the territory of the bear goblins, sweeping away all the remaining enemies from west to east. Wherever they passed, they were all included in the actual control area of the Zerg.

For such a large territory, the population of the Zerg and the Alliance combined is just a drop in the bucket. The population of the evil god camp cannot be rescued, so it can only be filled by Zerg puppies for the time being.

Each city or stronghold can only have a small team of Zerg puppies stationed. The territory should be occupied first, and the rest will be discussed later.

Faced with such a population dilemma, even if the Goblin Chamber of Commerce continues to help transport refugees, it is unknown how much time it will take to develop these places.

This population problem is one of the important reasons why Wu Qing wants to get rid of the Tengu and Naga tribes.

If the two tribes evacuate this area, they can only take away the core personnel and the army, and it is impossible to take away ordinary people.

Transporting a large number of people in this world is not an easy task and requires a great price.

These people who will eventually stay are exactly what Wu Qing needs.

If the population of the two tribes in this area can be successfully captured, the base of the Zerg can be basically supported.

It won't take long for the Zerg army to clean up the entire territory of the bear goblins and completely bring this huge territory under the control of the Zerg.

At that time, it will be the turn of the Zerg and the Naga tribe to attack the demon tribe from both sides.

The Zerg host has entered the territory of the demon tribe and is constantly collecting information about the territory of the demon tribe to prepare for the next attack.

From the information already obtained, Wu Qing found a very special situation, which is good news for the Zerg.

In addition to various demons and demon castles, the territory of the demon tribe also has normal territory cities and people of other races.

These people are basically people of various races in the local camp. They live an extremely cruel life and are tortured by demons every day.

Wu Qing discovered through the Zerg host that these people were not transformed into believers of the evil god, but maintained normal self-awareness and mental state. They were just props used by the demons to torture.

Wu Qing knew that these demons tortured others not for their own pleasure, but in this way to please the upper demons, which was the same as other evil god believers forcing others to believe in the evil god.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

Wu Qing learned about the situation of the demon clan from Naga through host No. 3 and obtained a lot of useful information.

Many upper demons are good at manipulating the emotions of intelligent creatures and improving their strength by absorbing the emotional energy of intelligent creatures.

True belief is actually an emotion, so there is no essential difference between what the evil god and the upper demon need, the difference is only in form.

In addition to working continuously and accumulating resources for the demon clan, the people in these demon clan territories have to endure various tortures to stimulate their emotional energy.

The upper demons can absorb these emotional energies in magical ways.

This looks a bit like a low-profile system resource collection capability. They can only absorb various emotional energies, while the system can absorb all kinds of energy except emotional energy as long as there is a causal relationship, and convert it into system resources.

In Wu Qing's view, these people who have been tortured into emotion-making machines in the demon territory still have a chance to be rescued. After so many hardships, those who have not gone completely crazy are all people with extremely firm wills.

These people are exactly what Wu Qing needs. This is equivalent to the demons helping Wu Qing select talents.

Driven by interests, Wu Qing can't wait to completely occupy the territory of the bear goblins, and is ready to take action against the demon territory.

Of course, the main combat force of the demons is still there, and some preparations need to be made before taking action.

...

The Zerg reinforcements supporting the Naga tribe have been like fish in water under the leadership of Nagalong in the past few days, and they can capture several front-line castles of the demon tribe every day.

Because of the containment of the Naga army, the demons simply cannot organize a large number of troops to deal with the Zerg reinforcements.

Wu Qing told Nagalong through Host No. 3 that the Zerg had defeated the Bugbears and asked Nagalong to report it.

The Zerg reinforcements performed too well, so Nagalong allocated a batch of luck beads for the Zerg, plus a large number of fire energy crystals seized from the Demons, and asked the Zerg to send a transport host to transport them.

Wu Qing asked the transport host to bring Nagalong several sets of equipment directly under the Spirit God Green Department to confirm the intelligence that the Bugbears sent a strong army, and also indirectly demonstrated the strength of the Zerg in this area.

Nagalong has been preparing for the counterattack against the Demons these days. She frequently exchanged information with Wu Qing through Nagalong and Host No. 3 to understand the progress of the Zerg army and the Bugbears.

After repeated communication, the two sides reached an agreement on cooperation in counterattacking the Demons, and they only waited for the Zerg to completely occupy the territory of the Bugbears before taking action.

…

In the Zerg underground world base, as Wu Qing expected, the ghouls attacked the Zerg defense line for a day and a night. With heavy losses, they could only accept their fate and no longer actively attack.

Then the powerful Zerg ground forces took the initiative to attack and clean up the territory of the ghouls.

Ghouls, ghoul buildings and the birthplace of the most important skeleton blood pool of the ghouls were all the targets of the Zerg army. None of them were spared. They pushed outward from the Zerg underground world base like a bulldozer.

A large number of Zerg hosts monitored the territory of the ghouls in real time and provided intelligence support for the ground combat forces.

Let the Zerg ground combat forces leave the Zerg base to fight, so that they will not be surrounded by the ghouls who have an absolute advantage in manpower.

With the information advantage on the battlefield, the Zerg army fought very easily. A large number of ghouls and limited buildings on the territory of the ghouls were eliminated and destroyed. There were very few buildings on the territory of the ghouls, and the Zerg did not know what these few buildings were used for.

The most important building was the place where the ghouls were born, the skeleton blood pool.

Each skeleton blood pool was guarded by a large number of ghouls. Every time the Zerg army attacked a skeleton blood pool, they would have a huge harvest.

The skeleton blood pool should be the place where the luck of the ghouls gathered. Every time the Zerg completely destroyed one, the system could get a lot of qi resources.

The Zerg army pushed forward all the way. The ghouls also organized several large sieges. The Zerg army, which had an absolute information advantage, calmly retreated to the Zerg base.

The Zerg's underground world base did not continue to expand, and the Zerg army continued to destroy the territory of the remaining ghouls.
